newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Feb container throughput falls 12.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Feb container throughput falls 12.8 pct.

text.p: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPAS) said on Thursday that February container throughput fell to 963,300 TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units), down 12.8 percent from January.
MPAS said in its latest monthly report that container throughput registered for January was was 1.1052 million TEU.
Total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in February also dropped to 23,240.3 million tonnes from January's 25,750 million tonnes, it said.
In February, 8,945 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,725 in November.
Bunker fuel sales for 380-centistoke fuel oil was 821,700 tonnes in February, down from 793,800 tonnes in January.
The 180-centistoke fuel oil sales were 341,300 tonnes, also down from January's 380,800 tonnes.
